name: AXIOM Native Capture
description: Opt-in local research capture of native gameplay callbacks and selected state.

capture-enabled.name: Enable local capture
capture-enabled.description: Records the next level start and resets locally. Capture stops on pause, death, finish or quit.

replay-enabled.name: Enable AXIOM command replay
replay-enabled.description: Reads replay.json from this mod's save directory at a true full start. Uses the declared command-call clock and blocks other requested input.
